messages:
mike: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered region rollout tonight. Window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Order: US -> EU -> APAC. Slices: 20% every 15m with a 5% canary for each region. Pin v2.4.1 as the immediate fallback for US, rollback target is v2.3.8. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency > 600ms for 5m. I posted the release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21/v2.4.2 (changelist, DB migration notes, config flags). Need SRE + oncall confirmation per region before canary kick.

jen: SRE — US warm pool available. We can prime ~150 GPUs in us-west in ~10m and run smoke. Will validate tail latencies during canary. I'm good to green-light US canary once smoke passes.

akshat: I'll schedule deploy-bot with the slices and pin/rollback policy. Deploy-bot, prepare a dry-run and queue job with the gating rules described by mike.

deploy-bot: queued job id=20260321-6880012345 (dry-run). Preflight results:
- US: capacity OK (warm pool 150 GPUs available)
- EU: capacity suboptimal (~70% warm; need +40 GPU warmup to meet slice sizing)
- APAC: warmup pending (maintenance window conflict at 03:30 UTC)
Dry-run smoke tests: pass for control path, no schema drift detected.

nora: EU ops — can add +40 GPUs within 20m if we want to keep the plan. Recommend holding EU ramp until warmup confirms and first US slice looks stable. Also watch thermal on eu-central.

oncall-eu: ack. We'll monitor thermal and pod evictions; will escalate at first sign of OOMs.

oncall-apac: apac note — there's a scheduled infra maintenance at 03:30-03:45 UTC that overlaps our current plan. Can we shift APAC ramp to start at 04:30 UTC instead?

mike: yes shift APAC to start at 04:30. Keep US->EU unchanged. We'll treat EU as gated on explicit "EU warm" from nora + two successful US slices.

akshat: updated schedule and requeued. New deploy-bot command (what I ran):
```
deploy-bot schedule \
  --job 6880012345 \
  --order us,eu,apac \
  --slices 20,20,20 \
  --slice-duration 15m \
  --canary 5% \
  --pin v2.4.1 \
  --rollback v2.3.8 \
  --gates "us:smoke_pass,eu:warm_confirm,eu:2_successful_slices"
```

jen: Suggest testing the rollback flow on the canary before EU ramp — do a simulated pinback to v2.3.8 on the canary instance and validate traffic shift. That ensures automation works under pressure.

deploy-bot: dry-run rollback test: simulated pinback success. Canary rollback completed in ~18s in dry-run. Smoke checks re-ran and passed on rollback path.

mike: perfect. I'll hold manual go at the US->EU gate. Oncall teams + SRE, please post smoke logs to the deploy thread when slices complete.

jen: will attach smoke logs to S3 (s3://redwood-deploys/6880012345/us-slice-1-smoke.log) and post summary here. First canary scheduled in ~12m.

akshat: note — release notes callers: we turned on the new kv-cache flag behind a rollout flag. If anything funky shows up, we can flip feature flag and avoid full rollback.

nora: EU warmup started (estimated ready in 18m). I'll post when warm pool hits target.

oncall-apac: noted, we'll standby for the shifted APAC start.

mike: thanks everyone. Plan: wait for jen smoke -> my manual go -> deploy-bot will run the US canary then ramp. EU holdpoint until warm_confirm + 2 success signals. APAC starts 04:30 UTC. If any region hits rollback triggers, deploy-bot will pin and revert per policy; operations will convene if rollback occurs. I'll update release slack when we start each regional step.

jen: smoke complete — no errors, p95 240ms, error rate 0.03%. logs: s3://redwood-deploys/6880012345/us-slice-1-smoke.log

mike: GO for US canary. akshat, flip it to execute.

akshat: executing now. deploy-bot told: starting US canary (5%). Will post progress updates every slice.

deploy-bot: US canary started. slice=5% -> target pool us-west. progress: creating canary replicas -> routing update -> smoke hook.

deploy-bot: US canary smoke hook: OK. metrics snapshot: error_rate=0.04% (5m), p95=260ms (5m), cpu/gpu util within expected range.

akshat: proceeding to ramp to 20% slices per plan. US slice 1 -> completed. Posting summary soon.

jen: US slice 1 metrics look stable. Proceeding.

mike: holding until 2 slices done, then will approve EU warm completion gate. Thanks team — posting final notes later.

-- end of thread --
